_comment: Klondike Solitaire locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. NEVER translate card labels/suits (e.g. A, 10, K, ♣️, ♦️, ♥️, ♠️), the pile tokens W, F1-F4, T1-T7, the ASCII board in {board}, or the commands 'draw', 'move', 'forfeit', 'all'. The bracket syntax like 'move W T1' must stay in Latin as-is.

_slots.{n}: Action index within a comma-separated command, 1-based
_slots.{msg}: A nested per-action result message (already localized)
_slots.{count}: Number of face-up cards being moved
_slots.{cmd}: The unknown command the player typed (not translated)
_slots.{max_turns}: The maximum number of turns before the game ends
_slots.{score}: Number of cards currently in the foundation piles
_slots.{stock}: Number of cards left in the stock
_slots.{waste}: The top waste card label, or '--' if empty (never translate)
_slots.{cards}: The cards in a pile as neutral labels, or '--' if empty (never translate)

player_prompt.intro:
Yaa taa ñu jàngal Klondike Solitaire. Sa xélit réew laa jéegooy xélit yii yépp ci pili fondasyon yi.

Nguur gi:
- Pili fondasyon yi (F1-F4): Dóotu ci Ass bi ba Kaamil ci wéeru
- Pili tablo yi (T1-T7): Dóotu wàcci ci bépp wéeru, xóot xóot (xóot bu xonk ci xóot bu ñuul, xóot bu ñuul ci xóot bu xonk)
- Stok: Yóotu kaart yi ci pili gañséen
- Gañséen (W): Kaart bu njëkk bi muy fésse ci jëf

Nguur jëf yi:
- 'draw' - Yóotu kaart yi ci stok jëm ci gañséen
- 'move <source> <destination> [count]' - Jéegooy kaart yi ci diggante pili yi
  Seetu: 'move W T1', 'move T1 F2', 'move T3 T5 2'. count itam man naa nekk 'all', bu ko defee ñu tóortóor a jéegooy kaart yi yépp yu néew.
- 'forfeit' - Jóotu njàngum bés bi ci sa tànnéef ci sa màndarga yu jëf
- Turu pili yi: W (gañséen), F1-F4 (fondasyon), T1-T7 (tablo)

Man ngaa jëf lu bari ci benn tur ci séparé ak virgul:
  Seetu: 'draw, move W T1, move T2 F1'

Réew laa Kaamil yi rekk man naa nekk ci pili tablo yu gàcc.
Jëf yi jëf ci ngóora - bu fekkee benn bi dañ, jëf yi ci des dal.
Jëf 'forfeit' bu la ko xélit nekkul dara xélit.

format_error.no_brackets: Jëfandikoo jëf ju amul solo. Doole na nekk ci ay kuréel.
format_error.no_closing_bracket: Jëfandikoo jëf ju amul solo. "]" buñ tënk ci lañuy jeexal
format_error.move_needs_args: Njiitu jëmale soxla na fu mu jóge ak fa muy jëm. Jëfandikoo: 'move <source> <destination> [count]'
format_error.count_positive: Jëfandikoo nañ ko ci "all" walla lu am solo.
format_error.count_invalid: Décompte moyoot. Jël benn lim ngoneem mbaa 'all'

action_result.before_failure: Jëfandikoo na {n} jëf ((s) laata mu ñàkk.

move_result.no_face_up: Duñ mën a yékkati ay kaar-dëkk.
